name: @pipeworx/mcp-medlineplus

tools.name: connect
tools.description: Map a clinical code (ICD-10-CM, SNOMED CT, RxCUI, LOINC, NDC, MeSH, HGNC) to MedlinePlus consumer-health topics.

code.description: Code value (e.g. "J00" for ICD-10-CM acute nasopharyngitis)

code_system.description: Short name or OID — ICD-10-CM | SNOMED | RxNorm | LOINC | NDC | MeSH | HGNC | ICD-9-CM

tools.name: search
tools.description: Free-text search across MedlinePlus topics (or related NLM databases).

db.description: healthTopics (default) | healthTopicsSpanish | drug | herb | meshhd | genetic

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-medlineplus forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the medlineplus pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
